svg.title: GainSec — printed circuit board profile
svg.desc: Top-down two-layer green printed circuit board representing the GitHub profile of GainSec (GainSec): four tones (mask over FR-4 #1a3222, mask over copper #2f451e, pad metal #b39c00, silk #e6e6e6). U1 (LQFP-100, the profile) marked GainSec REV A 1337. Zone 1 "SECURITY RESEARCH", a dashed silk courtyard of 12 TSSOP-8 chips: U4 Flock Safety [×4 2638]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Flock Safety" (anti-crime-ecosystem-research, BirdShot, Flock-Safety-Trap-Shooter-Sniffer-Alarm, flock-safety-falcon-sparrow-alpr-edl-firehose), latest push 2638; U5 Verkada [×5 2641]: 5 repositories from bullets mentioning "Verkada" (verkada-verkracked-alarm-hub-local-framework, verkada-verkracked-subghz-framework, verkada-verkracked-bullet-cam-cloud-emulator, VerkEye, verkada-verkracked-ambrella-CB62-firmwaredumper), latest push 2641; U6 Digital Ally [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Digital Ally" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U7 ThermoVu [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "ThermoVu" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U8 Uniview [×4 2627]: 4 repositories from bullets mentioning "Uniview" (DigitalAlly-ThermoVu-Uniview-Security-Research, Uniview-LAPI-Research-Toolkit, onvif-enum, tensorflow-generic-harness), latest push 2627; U9 Tridium Niagara [×1 2226]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Tridium Niagara" (CVE-2017-16744-and-CVE-2017-16748-Tridium-Niagara), latest push 2226; U10 Kapsch TrafficCom [×1 2536]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "V2X" (Phrack-72-Raw-Output-V2X), latest push 2536; U11 MacOS [×1 2634]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "MacOS" (macos-printer-simulator-security-research), latest push 2634; U12 AutoPro [×1 2627]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "AutoPro" (3rdParty-Carplay-AndroidAuto-Dongle-Security-Research), latest push 2627; U13 Mayton [×1 2627]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Mayton" (3rdParty-Carplay-AndroidAuto-Dongle-Security-Research), latest push 2627; U14 AOL [×1 2629]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "AOL" (AOL-Desktop-Gold-Security-Research), latest push 2629; U15 Little Tikes [×1 2525]: 1 repository from bullets mentioning "Little Tikes" (Little-Tikes-DreamProjector-Reverse-Engineering), latest push 2525. Vendor board: 12 of 12 vendor chips placed in 1 zone (2 columns, row pitch 4.12 mm). Each chip stands for the repositories linked from the README bullets that mention the vendor; its laser marking is the repository count and their latest push (YYWW). 19 of the 60 repositories in the data belong to at least one vendor; the matrix, test points and totals cover those. One 0.25 mm bus from U1 runs down every column and taps pin 1 of each chip. DS2 7×12 amber LED matrix, silk PUSH/WK = repositories pushed per ISO week (repos[].pushedAt — each repository's latest push, so a repository counts at most once) for the 12 weeks 2026-08-03 to 2026-10-22; each column is one week drawn as a bar lit from the bottom, one LED per event; 8 in total, max 3 in a week. Counts: W32 1, W33 0, W34 1, W35 0, W36 0, W37 2, W38 1, W39 0, W40 0, W41 3, W42 0, W43 0. No contribution data is used. Test pads TP1 GND, TP2 RX, TP3 TX (fixed labels; releases are not shown). Medium curated composition: U1, the DS2 matrix (every other week labelled), D1 HB and D2 TX at the left; the zones fill the rest, test pads along the bottom with the scope probe on TP3 (TX); J3 UART and its harness, the SWD header, bargraph, driver and flash are omitted at this width. Net list (H/V/45° routing, vias at layer changes): BUS U1–U4…U15 0.25 mm. 12 vendor chips on the board; 41 of the 60 repositories in the data match no vendor. 8 repositories pushed in the 12-week matrix window. Motion: D1 HB kernel heartbeat 70/245/70/875 ms (1260 ms period), D2 TX flashes from the last 12 days of pushes (one second per day, at most two 80 ms flashes), one 1.2 s matrix self-test sweep per 12 s loop, and one 0.6 s probe placement; copper, silk and parts never move. Data captured 2026-10-22T22:21:17.411Z.
